common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Middle Powers Coordinate
common.line: A coordination framework among the Union and other middle powers holding pieces of the AI supply chain — export-licence alignment, joint bargaining over compute access, shared evaluation capacity.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Anti datacentre blockades
notable.line: Coordinated physical blockades and legal challenges halt construction at multiple EU data-centre and gigafactory sites after the runaway-agent incident, delaying permitting by months.

notable.title: Insurance freeze
notable.line: Major EU insurers jointly suspend new cyber and liability cover for operators running agentic AI on uncertified infrastructure, freezing public tenders and hospital outsourcing until EU certification resumes.

notable.title: Insurer coverage retreat
notable.line: Major EU cyber-insurers announce coordinated withdrawal from covering public hospitals and utilities dependent on non-EU frontier models, citing unmodellable cutoff and agent-contamination risk, forcing emergency state backstop debate.
